guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：白光干涉表面輪廓儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: White-light interferometric profilometers
guides.concept: 以相干掃描干涉術（CSI）為核心，理解寬頻光源為何只在零光程差附近產生條紋、包絡與相位如何合成次奈米高度，再把干涉物鏡的數值孔徑、壓電掃描器、相機雜訊、蝙蝠翼邊緣誤差與異材相位差整合成可依 ISO 25178-600 校正與交付的表面輪廓量測工程。
guides.conceptEn: Built around coherence scanning interferometry (CSI), understand why a broadband source produces fringes only near zero optical-path difference and how envelope and phase combine into sub-nanometre height, then integrate objective numerical aperture, the piezo scanner, camera noise, batwing edge artefacts and dissimilar-material phase offsets into surface-topography metrology that can be calibrated and delivered per ISO 25178-600.
procedure: 白光干涉輪廓儀用 LED 或鹵素燈這類頻寬上百奈米的光源照明一個干涉物鏡，物鏡內部的分光膜把光分到待測表面與內建參考鏡。因為每個波長的條紋週期不同，只有在兩臂光程差接近零的位置各波長的條紋才同相疊加，離開零光程差幾個條紋後就互相抵消；於是條紋被一個寬度約等於相干長度的包絡包住，包絡的位置直接標記表面高度，沒有單色干涉儀每 λ/2 的相位模糊。整個表面高度圖由物鏡沿光軸掃描、每個像素各自找出包絡位置而得。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每個像素的相干圖可寫成 I(z) = I₀[1 + V·g(z − h)·cos(4π(z − h)/λ₀ + φ)]，g 是包絡、h 是表面高度、φ 是反射相位。只用包絡峰值定高度，重複性約在幾奈米；再利用包絡內條紋的相位可把高度精修到次奈米，但必須用包絡解開 λ/2 的整數模糊。頻域分析法對相干圖做傅立葉轉換，相位對波數的斜率給出高度（群速度等效），截距給出相位高度，兩者互相校驗。掃描取樣必須每個條紋至少四個點，否則相位會混疊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相干圖訊號與頻域分析」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

干涉物鏡有三種構型：Michelson 型在物鏡前方放分光立方體與側向參考鏡，只適合低倍率；Mirau 型把半透膜與一個小參考鏡疊在物鏡前方的玻璃板上，結構緊湊，覆蓋 10× 到 100×；Linnik 型用兩支相同物鏡分別對著樣品與參考鏡，可達最高數值孔徑但對準困難。橫向解析度由數值孔徑決定，可量測的最大表面斜率也由數值孔徑決定，因為鏡面反射光必須回到物鏡孔徑內；粗糙表面靠散射可略超過此限。Mirau 的參考鏡會遮住光瞳中心，使有效數值孔徑略小於標示值，並使高數值孔徑下的等效波長變長。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Mirau 干涉物鏡與數值孔徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

垂直掃描由壓電致動器帶動物鏡或整個干涉頭，以電容感測器閉迴路線性化，行程從 100 µm 到 1 mm 以上，長行程機型改用馬達配光學尺。掃描器的線性度直接變成高度比例誤差，因此儀器要以步高標準片校正放大係數。相機的滿井容量與讀出雜訊決定相位高度的雜訊底，大像素、高幀率與全域快門是優先選項。參考鏡的面形會原封不動加到每一張高度圖上，所以參考鏡用 λ/20 以上的超平面，或以多次平均的平面量測建立參考面扣除檔。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「壓電掃描器、相機與參考鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ISO 25178-600 把面輪廓儀的校正拆成幾個計量特性：量測雜訊、平面度偏差、放大係數、線性度偏差、x/y 尺度、解析度與垂直對準，各自有對應的實體標準片與程序，ISO 25178-604 則專門描述相干掃描干涉儀。放大係數用步高標準片校正，橫向尺度用已知節距的光柵或網格校正，平面度用超平面，雜訊用重複量測相減。這些結果合起來才能寫出高度、Sa、Sq 與節距等參數的不確定度，而且各特性必須在實際使用的物鏡與視場下分別做。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ISO 25178-600 計量特性與標準片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

當台階高度小於相干長度時，台階上下兩側的光在邊緣處繞射並互相干涉，包絡被扭曲，高度圖在邊緣兩側出現向外翹起的假尖峰，形狀像蝙蝠翼，幅度可達數十到上百奈米、寬度約等於橫向解析度。不同材料反射時的相位變化不同，例如金屬與介電質，使相位法高度產生與真實幾何無關的偏移。透明薄膜會在上表面與基板界面各產生一組包絡：膜的光學厚度大於相干長度的一半時兩組可分離並可同時量膜厚，否則合併成一個偏移且變寬的包絡，高度與膜厚都錯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「台階邊緣蝙蝠翼與異材相位差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相干掃描需要數秒，掃描期間任何相對於樣品的垂直振動都會扭曲相干圖，條紋相位對振動的靈敏度是 4π/λ₀，所以儀器安放在被動或主動隔振平台上並封在防風罩內；產線機型用高幀率相機縮短掃描時間，使振動更難進入。大面積量測以自動平台把多個視場拼接，相鄰視場重疊 20% 左右，用重疊區的高度差解出每個視場的活塞與傾斜，但誤差會沿拼接鏈累積。自動化還包含自動對焦找包絡、自動光強與自動樣品辨識，產能由掃描長度、幀率與拼接數決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「隔振平台、拼接與自動化」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

交付前要用獨立方法驗證：觸針式輪廓儀與原子力顯微鏡對材料相位不敏感，可用來比對台階高度與粗糙度；兩者的差異若落在合成不確定度內，表示材料修正與校正都正確。粗糙度參數還依賴濾波：ISO 25178 的 S 濾波（去除雜訊）與 L 濾波（去除形狀）截止值必須與比對方法一致，否則 Sa 與 Sq 不可比。交接報告列出每個計量特性的校正值與日期、各物鏡的不確定度預算、材料修正表、濾波設定與禁用條件（斜率、薄膜、台階高度範圍）。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「不確定度預算與交接報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A white-light profilometer illuminates an interference objective with an LED or halogen source of bandwidth above one hundred nanometres; a beamsplitter film inside the objective divides light between the test surface and a built-in reference mirror. Because every wavelength has a different fringe period, fringes of all wavelengths add in phase only where the two arms' optical paths nearly match and cancel a few fringes away; the fringes are therefore wrapped in an envelope about one coherence length wide whose position marks the surface height directly, with none of the λ/2 phase ambiguity of a monochromatic interferometer. A height map results from scanning the objective along its axis and locating the envelope independently in every pixel. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each pixel's correlogram is I(z) = I₀[1 + V·g(z − h)·cos(4π(z − h)/λ₀ + φ)], with g the envelope, h the surface height and φ the reflection phase. Locating the envelope peak alone gives height with a repeatability of a few nanometres; using the fringe phase inside the envelope refines it to sub-nanometre, but the envelope must resolve the λ/2 integer ambiguity. Frequency-domain analysis Fourier-transforms the correlogram: the slope of phase against wavenumber gives a group-velocity height and the intercept gives a phase height, and the two cross-check each other. Scan sampling needs at least four points per fringe or the phase aliases. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Correlogram signal and frequency-domain analysis”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Interference objectives come in three forms: Michelson puts a beamsplitter cube and side reference mirror ahead of the objective and suits only low magnification; Mirau stacks a semi-reflective film and a small reference mirror on a glass plate in front of the objective, compact and covering 10× to 100×; Linnik uses two matched objectives for sample and reference, reaching the highest numerical aperture but hard to align. Lateral resolution is set by numerical aperture, and so is the maximum measurable slope, because specularly reflected light must return inside the objective's aperture; rough surfaces exceed this slightly through scatter. The Mirau reference mirror obscures the pupil centre, making the effective numerical aperture a little below the nominal value and lengthening the equivalent wavelength at high aperture. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mirau interference objective and numerical aperture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Vertical scanning moves the objective or the whole interferometric head with a piezo actuator linearised by a capacitive sensor in closed loop, with travel from 100 µm to over 1 mm; long-range instruments switch to a motor with an optical scale. Scanner linearity becomes a height scale error directly, so instruments are calibrated with step-height standards for the amplification coefficient. Camera full-well capacity and read noise set the phase-height noise floor, favouring large pixels, high frame rate and global shutter. The reference mirror's figure is added unchanged to every height map, so the reference is a λ/20 or better superflat, or an averaged flat measurement builds a reference-subtraction file. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Piezo scanner, camera and reference mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

ISO 25178-600 breaks profilometer calibration into metrological characteristics: measurement noise, flatness deviation, amplification coefficient, linearity deviation, x/y scales, resolution and perpendicularity, each with its own physical standard and procedure, while ISO 25178-604 addresses coherence scanning interferometers specifically. Amplification is calibrated with step-height standards, lateral scale with gratings or grids of known pitch, flatness with a superflat and noise by subtracting repeated measurements. Only together do these results support uncertainty statements for height, Sa, Sq and pitch parameters, and every characteristic must be determined separately for each objective and field of view actually used. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ISO 25178-600 metrological characteristics and standards”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When a step is lower than the coherence length, light from the upper and lower levels diffracts at the edge and interferes, the envelope is distorted and false spikes rise outward on both sides of the edge, shaped like bat wings, with amplitudes of tens to over a hundred nanometres and widths about one lateral resolution. Different materials, for example metal versus dielectric, impose different reflection phase changes, so phase-based heights carry offsets unrelated to real geometry. A transparent film produces one envelope at its top surface and another at the substrate interface: if the film's optical thickness exceeds half the coherence length the two separate and thickness can be measured too, otherwise they merge into one shifted, broadened envelope and both height and thickness are wrong. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Batwings at step edges and dissimilar-material phase offset”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A coherence scan takes seconds, and any vertical vibration between instrument and sample during that time distorts the correlogram, the fringe phase being sensitive to vibration by 4π/λ₀, so instruments sit on passive or active isolation inside draught enclosures; production models use high-frame-rate cameras to shorten scans and shut vibration out. Large areas are covered by stitching fields with an automated stage, overlapping neighbours by about 20% and solving each field's piston and tilt from the overlap, but errors accumulate along the stitching chain. Automation adds auto-focus to find the envelope, auto-intensity and sample recognition, and throughput follows scan length, frame rate and the number of fields. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vibration isolation, stitching and automation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Before handoff, validate with independent methods: stylus profilers and atomic-force microscopes are insensitive to material phase and serve to compare step heights and roughness; agreement within the combined uncertainty shows that material corrections and calibrations are right. Roughness parameters also depend on filtering: the ISO 25178 S-filter (noise removal) and L-filter (form removal) cut-offs must match the comparison method or Sa and Sq are not comparable. The handoff report lists each metrological characteristic with its calibrated value and date, an uncertainty budget per objective, the material-correction table, filter settings and exclusion conditions (slope, thin films, step-height range). Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Uncertainty budget and handoff report”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 光源老化或濾光片偏移使光譜變窄，相干長度拉長到十幾微米，包絡變平、峰值定位變差，而且相鄰高度差小於包絡寬度的結構開始互相干擾，粗糙度讀值無故升高。
只在 10× 物鏡上校正放大係數，然後用 50× 物鏡量測；Mirau 物鏡在高數值孔徑下的等效波長變長，放大係數偏差 1% 以上，10 µm 的台階量成 10.1 µm，而校正紀錄看起來完整。
pitfallsEn: Source ageing or a shifted filter narrows the spectrum, stretches the coherence length to over ten micrometres, flattens the envelope and degrades peak location, while neighbouring structures whose height difference is below the envelope width start to interfere with each other and roughness readings rise without cause.

Calibrating amplification only with the 10× objective and then measuring with 50×: at high numerical aperture the Mirau equivalent wavelength lengthens, the amplification coefficient is off by over 1%, a 10 µm step reads 10.1 µm, and the calibration record looks complete.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 雷射干涉位移量測
related.transfer: 可遷移「低相干干涉與相干長度」與「放大係數、雜訊、平面度與橫向尺度的校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；雷射干涉位移量測的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Low-coherence interference and coherence length" and "Calibrating amplification, noise, flatness and lateral scale" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Laser-interferometric displacement metrology must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦低相干包絡定位、Mirau 干涉物鏡、垂直掃描與 ISO 25178 計量特性校正；雷射干涉位移量測則以外差式雷射干涉儀的條紋計數、空氣折射率補償與幾何誤差預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on low-coherence envelope localisation, Mirau interference objectives, vertical scanning and ISO 25178 metrological-characteristic calibration; Laser-interferometric displacement metrology centres on fringe counting, air-index compensation and geometric error budgets for heterodyne laser interferometers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」與「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雷射干涉位移量測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「Abbe 誤差、餘弦誤差與幾何誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope” and “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Laser-interferometric displacement metrology, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Abbe error, cosine error and the geometric error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 原子力顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「低相干干涉與相干長度」與「放大係數、雜訊、平面度與橫向尺度的校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；原子力顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Low-coherence interference and coherence length" and "Calibrating amplification, noise, flatness and lateral scale" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Atomic force microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦低相干包絡定位、Mirau 干涉物鏡、垂直掃描與 ISO 25178 計量特性校正；原子力顯微鏡則以懸臂力感測、光槓桿偵測、動態模式、彈簧常數校正與皮米級雜訊預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on low-coherence envelope localisation, Mirau interference objectives, vertical scanning and ISO 25178 metrological-characteristic calibration; Atomic force microscopes centres on cantilever force sensing, optical-lever detection, dynamic modes, spring-constant calibration and picometre noise budgets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」與「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到原子力顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「熱雜訊與偵測器雜訊預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope” and “Cantilever–tip–surface force”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Atomic force microscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Thermal and detector noise budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 白光干涉表面輪廓儀
history.text: 1980 年代中期 Davidson、Kino 等人把低相干光源與干涉顯微鏡結合，證明可用包絡位置量高度而不受 λ/2 模糊限制；1990 年代初 Zygo 的 Deck 與 de Groot 以頻域分析把相干掃描干涉術推向商用，Wyko（後併入 Veeco，再成為 Bruker 一部分）則以垂直掃描干涉術進入半導體與資料儲存產業。2010 年代 ISO 25178 系列把面輪廓量測的計量特性與校正程序標準化，其中 25178-604 專門規範相干掃描干涉儀，使不同廠牌儀器的量測可相互比較。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: In the mid-1980s Davidson, Kino and others combined low-coherence sources with interference microscopes, showing that envelope position measures height free of the λ/2 ambiguity; in the early 1990s Deck and de Groot at Zygo brought coherence scanning interferometry to market with frequency-domain analysis, while Wyko (later part of Veeco and then Bruker) entered semiconductor and data-storage industries with vertical scanning interferometry. In the 2010s the ISO 25178 series standardised metrological characteristics and calibration procedures for areal surface texture, with 25178-604 dedicated to coherence scanning interferometers, making measurements from different makers comparable. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「低相干干涉與相干長度」到「與觸針／AFM 比對、不確定度與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Low-coherence interference and coherence length" through "Comparison with stylus/AFM, uncertainty and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
